data.name: Aura of the Grave
data.description: At 3rd level, a seal-breaker is constantly surrounded by the chill of death. Mindless undead within 10 feet of the seal-breaker will not attack him unless directly ordered to, and even then only after succeeding at a Will save (DC = 10 + 1 /2 the seal-breaker's level + his Charisma modifier). This ability replaces aura of cowardice.
